name: mandatory-parent-wsl-v2
purpose: Sequential current-wheel WSL software-Vulkan mandatory observations with the original matching headless or Qt binding profile; no native production.
reuse: Borrow the original matching PyQt5, PyQt6 or PySide6 rootfs and its locked dependency site read-only (rootfs2 for PyQt6; original separate final-profile roots for PyQt5/PySide6). Reuse standalone CPython3.12.13, patched Mesa9c5, LLVM, qualified native collectors and exact Linuxa2715d26 wheel. No SDK/environment/rootfs/history copy, dependency refresh or network fallback.
consumer: Private mount namespace with read-only source/store/rootfs/Python/driver/runtime inputs. A small copied venv and64MiB tmpfs overlay install only the selected wheel over the original read-only dependency lower. Reports and POSIX temp each have64MiB tmpfs limits; private Xvfb ownership/readiness and actual exit/wait are recorded.
budget_basis: Reuse the512MiB installed WSL observation envelope. New regular visible files are capped240MiB, three tmpfs mounts192MiB and report retention copy64MiB, leaving16MiB margin. Borrowed read-only dependency lower is excluded from new-allocation accounting; the upper remains kernel-limited. Shared20GiB scratch and10GiB reserve stay unchanged.
checks: Current collector/scenario/source hashes; original seven-stage QWidget behavior; exact installed wheel/origins, discovery, dependency inventory and strict replay. Preserve every failed/UNVERIFIED attempt and bounded receipt extension. Rehash borrowed inputs after namespace exit. No transfer across bindings or to physical GPU/Metal qualification.
guards: Preflight guest filesystem plus C:/D: backing capacity and inherit all coordinator and previous guest protected/blocked paths. Inner periodic guards check guest/source/store reserves and bounded new writable files, tolerating only disappearing test-owned entries. Stop/wait owned children on timeout/capacity failure.
cleanup: Retain actual exits/waits, original reports/traces, preferred source/archive references, exact dependency/runtime identities and original licenses. Check host namespace has no remaining run mounts, rehash original debugger/driver/LLVM and load guest protected/blocked registry before managed Windows cleanup. Inspect/apply with registry613 and report results before the next row. Failed runs retain a reproducer.
change_basis: Same512MiB/kernel tmpfs limits and original binding-specific roots; selects a271candidate and reuses verified notices without copies.
